TT-EQUALITY-INDUCTION.statement: The equality-local foundation has reflexivity, right-based dependent equality induction, nondependent path action, and dependent path action.

TT-ELEMENTARY-INDUCTION.statement: Empty, Unit, Bool, and Nat have decoded classifiers, and the nontrivial elementary inductive carriers have dependent eliminators with constructor computation.

TT-SIGMA-PI-PATHS.statement: The groupoid layer has dependent-pair and dependent-function classifiers, observational Sigma paths, and a checked happly/funext equivalence for Pi paths.

CAT-ITERATED-HOMS.statement: A category has an object classifier and category-valued homs, so higher cells are represented by iterating Hom.

CAT-PATH-CATEGORY.statement: Path(A) internalizes equality as a groupoidal category, and an ordinary function induces an iterable functor between path categories.

CAT-FUNCTOR-CALCULUS.statement: Ordinary functors expose object and iterated-hom action, with generic identity and composition computation rather than constructor-specific functor laws.

CAT-PRODUCT-CALCULUS.statement: Binary product categories have projection functors and a stable two-sided product-map constructor whose object, arrow, and projection observations compute componentwise.

reviewers.contains: product/projection cut used by the book
General two-sided product maps used by profunctor reindexing

CUT-PRODUCT-PROJECTION.statement: In the Cat-specialized case, for h:A0→A1, k:B0→B1, and g:A1→C, the readable equation pi1^*(g) composed with h×k equals pi1'^*(g composed with h); its owner-aligned projection and nested-precomposition forms are checked, while the literal raw projection-composite equality is not packaged.

reviewers.contains: product/projection cut used by the book

CAT-HOM-CUTS.statement: Represented-hom postcomposition and precomposition have distinct stable full and capped owners with identity, consecutive-action, adjacent-cut, and proof-time ordinary-composition comparisons.

CAT-TRANSFOR-CALCULUS.statement: Transformations form the next hom between functors and expose point components together with higher naturality action.

CAT-DIRECTED-FAMILIES.statement: A Cat-valued directed family has fibres and functorial reindexing, while a family morphism has fibre functors and directed comparison cells.

CAT-SIGMA-PI.statement: Directed families have a Sigma total category, canonical transport arrows, and a Pi section category with coherent evaluation.

CAT-REPRESENTABLE.statement: The fixed-source representable family has fibre Hom(x,y), and its source action is precomposition.

LOGIC-TRUNCATION-PREDICATE.statement: Contractibility and recursive truncation evidence define the proposition, set, and groupoid levels as properties of existing classifiers.

LOGIC-NAT-SETHOOD.statement: Unit and Empty are proposition-valued and Nat is set-valued by explicit internal evidence.

LOGIC-TRUNCATION-EVIDENCE-PROP.statement: For every truncation level and classifier, the classifier of truncation evidence is proposition-valued.

EQUIV-TYPE.statement: TypeEquiv packages a forward map with contractible homotopy fibres and exposes a selected inverse with both inverse paths.

EQUIV-TYPE-ALGEBRA.statement: Type equivalences have reflexivity, symmetry, and categorical-order composition with checked forward-map computation.

UNIV-GROUPOID.statement: The groupoid universe has a decoder-oriented univalence equivalence between universe paths and TypeEquiv, with named round trips and transport agreement.

UNIV-TRUNCATED.statement: For packaged n-truncated classifiers, package equality is equivalent to TypeEquiv of the retained carriers, with named encode/decode round trips.

EQUIV-OMEGA.statement: OmegaEquivAlong carries equality-valued inverse-arrow data, OmegaEquiv packages a selected arrow, and an object path has a transparent computational equivalence package.

EQUIV-EVIDENCE-PROP.statement: For every fixed arrow, its equality-valued OmegaEquivAlong evidence is proposition-valued without a finite-dimensional hypothesis.

EQUIV-HOM-ACTION.statement: Equality-valued equivalence evidence has a one-way next-hom action, and coherent groupoidality makes directed fibre transport an equivalence.

EQUIV-ORDINARY-ISO-LIFT.statement: Ordinary categorical isomorphism evidence has a one-way lift to the native equality-valued OmegaEquiv package.

UNIV-FULL-OBJECT-ISO.statement: A full native equivalence between arbitrary categorical object equality and ordinary isomorphism evidence is not part of the selected API.

IND-PATHOUT.statement: PathOut_Z(x) is the Sigma total of the fixed-source representable, with a reflexive object and a canonical rho arrow to every outgoing arrow.

IND-ARROW.statement: Fixed-source arrow induction extends data at the reflexive outgoing arrow to a section, and the theorem is internalized functorially as fixed-source and varying-source interfaces.

IND-COMPOSITION.statement: Applying arrow induction to the represented composition motive yields a functor whose object action computes to categorical composition.

IND-PATH-COMPARISON.statement: For a literal path-category base, structured directed transport agrees propositionally with primitive right-based equality induction.

IND-GENERAL-INITIALITY.statement: A general theorem identifying all selected categorical induction interfaces with homotopy-initial algebras has not been packaged.

DHIT-DERIVED-ELIMINATORS.statement: The contextual WalkingEnd eliminator specializes to a dependent section and an ordinary recursor with base and generator observations.

DHIT-GENERAL-SCHEMA.statement: The selected WalkingEnd interface does not yet constitute a reusable schema for arbitrary directed higher-inductive categories, pushouts, or cell complexes.

TRUNC-CLOSURE.statement: Recursive truncation evidence is monotone and has checked dependent Pi and same-level dependent Sigma closure operations.

TRUNC-RETRACT.statement: Every recursive truncation level is closed under explicit retractions.

CAT-DIMENSION.statement: IsNCat defines finite directed height by hom recursion, and every such category has the recursively predicted object-truncation evidence.

TRUNC-REFLECTOR.statement: The active truncation layer supplies properties and packaged truncated universes, not a general truncation reflector or arbitrary truncation HIT.

WE-SIGNATURE.statement: WalkingEnd has an opaque category, base, directed loop, and explicit one-dimensional evidence.

WE-ONE-DIMENSIONAL.statement: Every WalkingEnd hom-category is discrete, without WalkingEnd itself becoming discrete.

WE-CONTEXTUAL-ELIMINATOR.statement: The contextual WalkingEnd eliminator has base and loop computation at the selected displayed observers.

WE-BNAT-MODEL.statement: BNat is a separate one-object Nat-monoid model and receives a functor from WalkingEnd.

WE-CODE.statement: Code sends the walking base to Path(Nat) and the walking loop to the Nat successor functor.

WE-ENCODE.statement: Encode acts with Code on a based arrow and evaluates at zero.

WE-POWER.statement: Natural powers map zero to identity and successor to generator-prefix composition.

WE-SPIRAL.statement: The selected explicit-kappa directed spiral supplies the loop coherence for powers.

WE-CONTEXTUAL-DECODER.statement: The contextual decoder maps Code to the based representable and computes to powers at the base.

WE-NORMALIZATION-CELL.statement: Every based arrow has a directed normalization cell toward decode(encode(p)).

WE-NORMALIZATION-PATH.statement: Hom-discreteness converts the directed normalization cell into equality.

WE-POWER-ENCODE.statement: For a based endomorphism p, power(encode(p)) equals p.

WE-ENCODE-POWER.statement: For every natural n, encode(power(n)) equals n.

WE-HOM-NAT-CARRIER.statement: The underlying based-endomorphism carrier is equivalent to Nat.

WE-HOM-SETHOOD.statement: The based-endomorphism carrier is a set both from dimension and from the Nat equivalence.

WE-LOOP-NOT-IDENTITY.statement: The walking generator is not equal to the identity.

WE-LOOP-NO-RIGHT-INVERSE.statement: The walking generator has no right inverse.

WE-LOOP-NONINVERTIBLE.statement: The walking generator carries no native omega-equivalence evidence.

WE-ENCODE-PREFIX.statement: Encoding a generator-prefixed based endomorphism produces the successor of its code.

WE-STRUCTURED-ENCODER.statement: The based encoder is also packaged as a functor from the based hom-category to Path(Nat).

WE-COMPOSITION-ADDITION.statement: Compatibility of based composition with Nat addition follows from the checked power recursion, inverse laws, and ordinary category/Nat induction, but is not packaged as a monoid equivalence.

WE-FULL-CATEGORICAL-COMPARISON.statement: A reverse BNat functor, full hom-category equivalence, and functor-category initiality require additional reusable infrastructure.

WE-GROUP-COMPLETION.statement: Group completion toward BInt or the circle comparison has not been implemented.

TRANSF-POINT-OFFDIAGONAL.statement: An ordinary transfor has point components and an iterable off-diagonal hom action from F(x) to G(y) along every source arrow x to y.

TRANSF-STRICT-NATURALITY.statement: Postcomposition and precomposition adjacent to an ordinary transfor's off-diagonal action reduce to the action on the corresponding composite source arrow.

owners.contains: Full strict naturality for ordinary transfors

reviewers.contains: Full strict naturality: post/left accumulation before capping

TRANSF-HORIZONTAL-CALCULUS.statement: The product-composition action supplies an iterable horizontal composite of a pair of ordinary transfors, with checked point, full off-diagonal, and capped off-diagonal projections.

TRANSFD-FIBRE-COMPONENTS.statement: A natural family transformation between displayed functors has a transformation in every fibre and a point component at every fibre object, with identity and vertical composition inherited from the generic transfor calculus.

FUNCTORD-DISPLAYED-LAXITY.statement: For a natural family morphism and a base arrow, the internal displayed hom action supplies a directed component from target transport after the source fibre functor to the target fibre functor after source transport.

FUNCTORD-SIGMA-ACTION.statement: The Sigma-total map induced by a natural family morphism sends a total arrow to the same base arrow paired with the capped internal displayed hom action in the fibre.

FUNCTORD-WHOLE-LAXITY.statement: A standalone whole-transfor laxity facade between the two transport composites is intentionally deferred; the active owner is the internal displayed hom action and its component projections.

PROF-CATEGORY.statement: A Cat-valued profunctor from A to B is a directed family on A opposite times B, and vertical profunctor maps are natural family morphisms with the existing identity and composition calculus.

reviewers.contains: Cat-valued profunctor facade and representable hom action

PROF-REPRESENTABLE.statement: The unit profunctor evaluates to the ambient hom, and reindexing it along endpoint functors gives the binary representable with action by precomposition and postcomposition.

PROF-REINDEXING.statement: Profunctors reindex functorially in both endpoints by pullback along an opposite-times-covariant product map, including identity, nesting, and representable accumulation laws.

reviewers.contains: Stable profunctor reindexing and its representable fold

PROF-REPRESENTATION-PACKAGE.statement: Representability of a profunctor is expressible as ordinary isomorphism to a conjoint, and a representation package retains a chosen representing functor with that evidence.

PROF-COMPARISON-BETA-ETA.statement: A computational profunctor comparison exposes mutually inverse push and pull operations on every incoming profunctor map, with runtime beta and eta reductions and functorial reindexing and composition.

reviewers.contains: Computational profunctor comparisons and weighted representability

PROF-SHAPED-CELLS.statement: A profunctor cell over endpoint functors is a natural family morphism into a reindexed target; unit-source specialization and narrow cell application provide shaped elements and their action.

PROF-TENSOR.statement: The selected profunctor tensor is an opaque fixed-middle composite with exposed-endpoint reindexing and a fixed-endpoint bifunctorial map action.

reviewers.contains: Primitive profunctor tensor and exposed-endpoint reindexing

PROF-CLOSED-CALCULUS.statement: The two selected profunctor residuals expose fixed-endpoint evaluation and lambda operations inverse by runtime beta and eta, without asserting semantic end formulas for their opaque objects.

PROF-COYONEDA.statement: Tensoring on either side with the unit profunctor has a natural co-Yoneda map to the original profunctor, with fixed shaped-element beta and naturality-fusion computations.

PROF-GENERAL-COEND.statement: The selected opaque tensor and co-Yoneda computations do not yet provide a general coend or coinserter construction, tensor associativity package, or a bicategory of profunctors.

YONEDA-FULLY-FAITHFUL.statement: The active representable and co-Yoneda interfaces do not yet package a general fully faithful Yoneda embedding or the full Yoneda equivalence for arbitrary Cat-valued presheaves.

UCAT-IDENTITY-ISOMORPHISM.statement: In the ordinary set-valued-hom specialization, a category is a precategory whose identity-to-isomorphism map is an equivalence; its object type is consequently a 1-type.

UCAT-FUNCTOR-CATEGORY.statement: An ordinary natural transformation is invertible exactly when its components are, and for a precategory A and univalent category B the functor precategory from A to B is univalent, with functor identity corresponding to natural isomorphism.

UCAT-ADJOINT-REPRESENTABILITY.statement: In ordinary univalent 1-category theory, right adjoints are equivalently coherent representations of the contravariant hom functors obtained by fixing the target of the left adjoint.

UCAT-ADJOINT-UNIQUENESS.statement: For an ordinary functor whose source is a univalent category, right-adjoint structures are unique in the appropriate identity sense and existence of a right adjoint is a mere proposition.

UCAT-EQUIVALENCE-CRITERIA.statement: Ordinary adjoint equivalences correspond to fully faithful and split essentially surjective functors, and between univalent categories mere essential surjectivity suffices.

UCAT-CATEGORY-IDENTITY.statement: Identity of ordinary precategories corresponds to isomorphism of precategories, and for univalent categories this agrees with categorical equivalence; the resulting type of categories is a 2-type.

UCAT-YONEDA.statement: The ordinary set-valued Yoneda evaluation map is an equivalence, making the Yoneda embedding fully faithful and representing objects unique up to isomorphism, hence up to identity in a univalent category.

UCAT-STRICT-CATEGORY.statement: An ordinary HoTT strict category is a precategory whose object type is a set; it need not be univalent, and an ordinary univalent category is strict exactly when it is gaunt.

UCAT-DAGGER-CATEGORY.statement: An ordinary dagger precategory has a chosen identity-on-objects contravariant involution; unitary arrows use the dagger as inverse, and dagger univalence identifies object identity with unitary isomorphism.

UCAT-STRUCTURE-IDENTITY.statement: For a standard proposition-valued notion of structure over an ordinary univalent category, the precategory of structured objects and structure-preserving arrows is itself univalent.

UCAT-REZK-COMPLETION.statement: Every ordinary precategory admits a fully faithful and essentially surjective map into a univalent category, constructible by a Yoneda image or a 1-truncated HIT; univalent categories are exactly the targets that invert all such weak equivalences by precomposition.

NATIVE-DAGGER-INTERFACE.statement: The active opposite operation does not provide a chosen identity-on-objects involutive self-duality, coherent higher dagger action, a unitary classifier, or native dagger univalence.

NATIVE-STRUCTURE-IDENTITY.statement: A generic native structure identity theorem requires a directed structure signature, a higher structure-preserving equivalence classifier, qualified base univalence, and coherent off-diagonal and next-hom action.

NATIVE-REZK-COMPLETION.statement: No selected native saturation predicate, Rezk completion object, unit weak equivalence, or iterable higher mapping property is currently implemented.

ADJ-TRIANGLE-CUTS.statement: An indexed adjunction exposes stable unit and counit observations whose two component-level triangle cuts reduce to the corresponding functorial composites.

reviewers.contains: Indexed adjunction triangles, opposite, and operation-trust boundary

ADJ-HOM-PROF-COMPARISON.statement: An indexed adjunction supplies a reindexable profunctor comparison between Hom_B(LM,F) and Hom_A(M,RF), whose push and pull inherit the generic comparison beta and eta laws.

WEIGHTED-LIMIT-REPRESENTABILITY.statement: A parameterized weighted-cone profunctor is formed by the selected covariant residual, and its computational representation by a functor exposes inverse push and pull operations on every reindexed incoming profunctor map.

reviewers.contains: Computational profunctor comparisons and weighted representability

WEIGHTED-LIMIT-SPECIALIZATIONS.statement: Terminal weights and conjoint weights inhabit the selected weighted-limit classifier, so the general right-adjoint preservation construction specializes to the corresponding conical-limit and right-Kan interfaces; this does not assert their missing semantic end identifications.

reviewers.contains: Weighted limit and colimit specialization typing

WEIGHTED-END-KAN-SEMANTICS.statement: With semantic ends and coends, terminal weights recover ordinary cone and cocone categories while conjoint and companion weights recover the standard pointwise right and left Kan extension formulas.

DEPENDENT-ADJUNCTIONS.statement: A general dependent Sigma-change-of-base-Pi adjunction chain requires base-arrow action, off-diagonal and next-hom coherence, and Beck-Chevalley comparisons beyond the current Sigma and Pi family interfaces.

OP-DUALITY.statement: Opposite category, functor, transfor, and adjunction operations expose the selected involutive and variance-reversing computations used by the duality arguments.

WEIGHTED-LIMIT-PRESERVATION.statement: The selected profunctor comparison certifying a weighted limit is transported by an indexed right adjoint to a weighted-limit comparison for the composed diagram and cone point.

WEIGHTED-COLIMIT-PRESERVATION.statement: Weighted colimits are presented through opposite weighted limits, and the selected left-adjoint preservation certificate is derived by applying right-adjoint preservation to the opposite adjunction.

WEIGHTED-COLIMIT-SPECIALIZATIONS.statement: Terminal weights and companion weights inhabit the selected opposite-defined weighted-colimit classifier, so left-adjoint preservation specializes to the corresponding conical-colimit and left-Kan interfaces without supplying semantic coend identifications.

reviewers.contains: Weighted limit and colimit specialization typing

JOIN-RECURSOR.statement: The primitive directed join has two inclusion functors, an internally natural cross cell, and a nondependent recursor with beta computation on both inclusions and the cross-cell datum.

JOIN-COLLAGE-BOUNDARY.statement: The join recursor has the input shape of the collage of the terminal profunctor, but no object or hom decomposition, mapping-category equivalence, opposite comparison, or dependent collage eliminator is active.

FORMAL-KERNEL-PRESENTATION.statement: The active v3.2 modules expose categories, iterated homs, functors, transfors, and directed families through explicit classifiers and full or capped application owners, with executable assertions checking representative typing and computation.

FORMAL-ELABORATION-BOUNDARY.statement: The canonical mathematical surface has no current production parser and end-to-end compiler to the active Lambdapi owners; the parent TypeScript prototype is read-only feasibility evidence and is absent from the book build graph.

FORMAL-METATHEORY-BOUNDARY.statement: Local source acceptance, diagnostics, warning inventories, and model examples do not establish global confluence, strong normalization, canonicity, decidability, consistency, or semantic soundness for the whole emdash rewrite and unification theory.

EH-COMMUTATIVITY.statement: Two 2-endomorphisms of an identity 1-cell commute in the selected Eckmann-Hilton slice.
